claims.claim_text: The indexed John D. Bugni is confirmed as the Army entrant represented by the exact-name and private-identifier match in the official merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact full name, middle initial, and private identifier match across the OSS index and official Army-entry file; the identifier is withheld.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact private identifier and exact normalized full name.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army-entry record is dated February 10, 1942; the index does not provide an OSS transfer date.
claims.match_notes: Namesakes lacking the private identifier or Box 91 linkage were rejected.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry, John D. Bugni was recorded in the forestry occupations except logging group.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official record carries code 391, which NARA's numerical list maps to forestry occupations except logging.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by exact private identifier and full indexed name.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded to Army entry on February 10, 1942; the relation to OSS recruitment is unknown.
claims.match_notes: No employer, agency, forestry specialty, workplace, exact duties, or immediate OSS predecessor is inferred.
